resolution.note: Roll d20 + relevant ability mod + proficiency if a fitting skill/tool applies.

minor_strain.definition: A short-lived stress condition representing fatigue, dread, numbness, exposure, or emotional overload.
default_mechanics: While you have Minor Strain, you take -1 on your next d20 roll that meaningfully relates to the cause (GM decides).
Minor Strain clears on a short rest, or earlier if fictionally addressed (warmth, witness, ritual, remedy).
minor_strain.stacking: If gained again while you already have it, upgrade to 'Major Strain' at GM option (or apply one additional -1 on a second relevant roll).

suggested_spell_feature_tagging: Prefer explicit tags on spells/features in your toolchain; use damage types as fallback.
Fallback mapping examples: fire->fire; cold->ice/water; thunder->air; lightning->air(storm); poison/disease->charnelix_blight; psychic/fear/illusion/silence->varook_silence; bludgeoning/stone->earth.

manifest.conflict_rule: If multiple versions exist, the manifest-listed IDs are authoritative.

habitation.notes: Rivers/coasts support trade, diplomacy, and healers.

passive_choose_1.name: Waterwise
passive_choose_1.rule_text: Once per scene, add +PB to Medicine, Insight, Survival, or Nature when it meaningfully involves water, weather, currents, purification, healing, or diplomacy-by-ritual.

passive_choose_1.name: Current-Touched Casting
passive_choose_1.rule_text: For WATER-tagged spells/features, choose permanently: +1 spell attack OR +1 spell save DC.

surge_1_per_short_rest.name: Luminflux Surge
surge_1_per_short_rest.rule_text: After a WATER-tagged spell/feature, choose: +1d6 healing/damage OR end one minor condition (recommended: poisoned; or Blighted(1)).

adventure_moves.name: Read the Current
adventure_moves.trigger: When you study shifting situations—politics, storms, lies, faction tension, looming danger.
adventure_moves.strong_hit: Ask 3 questions; +1 forward acting on an answer.
adventure_moves.weak_hit: Ask 2 questions; GM adds a cost (time/attention/favor debt).
adventure_moves.miss: You misread; GM advances an opposing clock or reveals an undertow.

adventure_moves.name: Cleanse What Clings
adventure_moves.trigger: When you attempt to purify poison, rot, curse residue, or emotional stain.
adventure_moves.strong_hit: Remove it cleanly; gain a boon.
adventure_moves.weak_hit: Remove it, but it relocates (downstream/object/onto you: Minor Strain).
adventure_moves.miss: It spreads or attracts something hungry.

adventure_moves.name: Mediate at the Waterline
adventure_moves.trigger: When you prevent conflict where passage/water rights/old borders are at stake.

passive_choose_1.name: Greenhand
passive_choose_1.rule_text: Once per scene, add +PB to Nature, Medicine, Animal Handling, or Survival for cultivation/ecosystems/antidotes/community care.

passive_choose_1.name: Verdant Casting
passive_choose_1.rule_text: For VERDANT-tagged spells/features, choose permanently: +1 spell attack OR +1 spell save DC.

surge_1_per_short_rest.name: Mutualism Surge
surge_1_per_short_rest.rule_text: When you heal/stabilize, grant temp HP = PB and choose: stand without movement OR move 5 ft without provoking.

adventure_moves.name: Hear the Green
adventure_moves.trigger: When you ask the land for guidance—paths, migrations, hidden dangers, who belongs where.
adventure_moves.strong_hit: Clear answer; +1 forward; learn an extra truth.
adventure_moves.miss: Something else answers in its voice.

adventure_moves.name: Harvest Without Harm
adventure_moves.trigger: When you take resources without breaking the covenant.
adventure_moves.strong_hit: Take what you need; improve the site.
adventure_moves.weak_hit: Take it, but pay a cost (trace/debt/attention).
adventure_moves.miss: You damage the system; consequences ripple.

adventure_moves.name: Keep the Covenant
adventure_moves.trigger: When you hold peace in a living ecosystem: factions/species/water rights.

habitation.notes: Inhabited by Emberkin and hardy enclaves; dangerous inner biomes.

passive_choose_1.name: Heatwise
passive_choose_1.rule_text: Once per scene, add +PB to Nature, Survival, Athletics, or Intimidation when heat/volcanic terrain/fire ecology/rites apply.

passive_choose_1.name: Flameborne Casting
passive_choose_1.rule_text: For FIRE-tagged spells/features, choose permanently: +1 spell attack OR +1 spell save DC.

surge_1_per_short_rest.name: Spark of Renewal
surge_1_per_short_rest.rule_text: After dealing FIRE damage or completing a FIRE technique, choose: +1d6 FIRE damage OR temp HP = PB + CON mod (min 1).

adventure_moves.name: Listen to the Whispering Burn
adventure_moves.trigger: When you read Emberwood’s living memory in soil/ash/mycelium/lava tubes.
adventure_moves.weak_hit: 2 answers, but you mirror an emotion or draw predator attention (Minor Strain).
adventure_moves.miss: The jungle misleads or reacts territorially.

adventure_moves.name: Cross the Lava Veins
adventure_moves.trigger: When you traverse lava rivers/obsidian ground/volcanic pools safely.
adventure_moves.strong_hit: Cross cleanly; find an advantage (shortcut/safe ledge/tunnel).
adventure_moves.weak_hit: Cross, but pay a cost (scorch gear/lose time/split group/attention).

adventure_moves.name: Inferno Dance of Claiming
adventure_moves.trigger: When you earn Emberkin trust or invoke tradition at a volcanic site.

habitation.notes: Aeris enclaves and sky-cities; many routes are lethal without guidance.

passive_choose_1.name: Windwise
passive_choose_1.rule_text: Once per scene, add +PB to Acrobatics, Perception, Survival, or Nature when reading wind/navigating heights/predicting storms.

passive_choose_1.name: Gale-Touched Casting
passive_choose_1.rule_text: For AIR-tagged spells/features, choose permanently: +1 spell attack OR +1 spell save DC.

surge_1_per_short_rest.name: Borrowed Wings
surge_1_per_short_rest.rule_text: Reaction: reduce forced movement by 15 ft and move 10 ft without provoking; if airborne instead gain advantage on next DEX save before end of next turn.

adventure_moves.name: Read the Wind Language
adventure_moves.trigger: When you interpret wind/cloud/pressure to find safe routes or storm omens.

adventure_moves.name: Cross the Mist Bridges
adventure_moves.trigger: When you traverse airy bridges/wind tunnels/Cloudspire approaches.
adventure_moves.strong_hit: Cross cleanly; help one ally (+1 forward).
adventure_moves.weak_hit: Cross, but choose: leave something, split briefly, or Minor Strain.

adventure_moves.name: Appeal to the Aeris
adventure_moves.trigger: When you seek Aeris hospitality or access to sacred places.

habitation.notes: Sparse; Ashwalker nomads; outposts are temporary by custom.

passive_choose_1.name: Stonegrit
passive_choose_1.rule_text: Once per scene, add +PB to Survival, Insight, Religion, or Athletics for endurance, resisting despair, interpreting omens, navigating by purpose.

passive_choose_1.name: Griefbound Casting
passive_choose_1.rule_text: For EARTH-tagged spells/features, choose permanently: +1 spell attack OR +1 spell save DC.

surge_1_per_short_rest.name: Sacred Weight
surge_1_per_short_rest.rule_text: When you would fail a WIS save or Insight check, reroll. If success, gain temp HP = PB. If still fail, you succeed but are Slowed (-10 ft) until end of next turn.

adventure_moves.name: Walk With Purpose
adventure_moves.trigger: When you cross the cracked plains where intention draws attention.
adventure_moves.strong_hit: Choose 2: safer route; avoid pursuit; learn lingering sorrow; arrive early.
adventure_moves.weak_hit: Make it, but pay cost (time/trace/Minor Strain).

adventure_moves.name: Bind the Sorrow
adventure_moves.trigger: When you chant/rite to prevent despair sinking deeper into a person/place.
adventure_moves.strong_hit: Hold sorrow; remove a fear/despair condition or reduce a despair clock by 2.
adventure_moves.weak_hit: It holds, but echoes outward; the land marks you.
adventure_moves.miss: You awaken what you tried to bind; escalation.

adventure_moves.name: Descend the Question
adventure_moves.trigger: When you approach the Endless Maw seeking truth.
adventure_moves.strong_hit: Ask 2 questions; get direct useful answers; learn a safe boundary.
adventure_moves.weak_hit: Learn an answer, but it costs: memory detail/comfort/vow complication.

habitation.notes: Frostborn culture survives via cairns, whisperers, and citadel refuge.

passive_choose_1.name: Icewise
passive_choose_1.rule_text: Once per scene, add +PB to Survival, Perception, Athletics, or Nature when navigating whiteouts, reading ice, tracking across snow, enduring exposure.

passive_choose_1.name: Frosttouched Casting
passive_choose_1.rule_text: For ICE/WINTER-tagged spells/features, choose permanently: +1 spell attack OR +1 spell save DC.

surge_1_per_short_rest.name: Soulfrost Focus
surge_1_per_short_rest.rule_text: After cold damage or an ICE/WINTER save, choose: +1d6 cold damage OR target speed -10 ft until start of your next turn (no save) OR you gain cold resistance until end of your next turn.

adventure_moves.name: Read the Cracks
adventure_moves.trigger: When you interpret ice fractures, wind pressure, omen-patterns.
adventure_moves.strong_hit: Ask 3 questions; +1 forward acting on one.

adventure_moves.name: Follow the Aurora
adventure_moves.trigger: When you chase auroras to find hidden paths.
adventure_moves.weak_hit: Find path, but narrow: split/Minor Strain/lose something.
adventure_moves.miss: Lights lead to true but dangerous place.

adventure_moves.name: Weather the Veilstorm
adventure_moves.roll: CON (group check) or WIS(Survival) led by a guide
adventure_moves.trigger: When a Veilstorm bears down and you must keep the party from becoming brittle statues.
adventure_moves.strong_hit: Survive intact; keep one benefit (supplies/morale/quick shelter).
adventure_moves.miss: Someone is caught; rescue under pressure.

habitation.notes: Edge hamlets/ward-sites; deep interior is effectively uninhabitable.
Outer Mire supports desperate camps; deep mire is lethal.

overlays.notes: Use this overlay when Emberwood is actively ‘awake’—volcanic pulse, rites, or territorial response.

track.name: Heat Debt
increase_triggers: Crossing lava/obsidian hazards without adequate preparation (failed travel move or CON save).
Overusing fire rites/techniques in a single scene (GM-defined threshold).
Taking fire damage while already Scorched, or pushing through exhaustion.

effects: Scorched: your next Stealth or Concentration-related d20 roll takes -1 (Minor Strain flavor).
Heat Haze: disadvantage on your next concentration check OR ranged attack roll (your choice).
Ignition Event: the environment flares (lava surge/emberstorm). GM introduces a hard choice: lose route, lose supplies, or split the group.

moves.name: Ride the Heat
moves.trigger: When you use Emberwood’s heat to gain an advantage (speed, intimidation, forging a path).
moves.strong_hit: You gain the advantage cleanly; reduce Heat Debt by 1.
moves.weak_hit: You gain it, but Heat Debt +1 or take Minor Strain.
moves.miss: The heat bites back; Heat Debt +2 and a hazard manifests.

moves.name: Quench or Feed
moves.trigger: When you try to cool, vent, or redirect dangerous heat (lava tube, emberstorm).
moves.strong_hit: You redirect safely; create a safe zone or shortcut.
moves.weak_hit: You succeed, but something valuable is scorched or a predator is drawn.
moves.miss: A surge occurs; the party must choose between safety and an objective.

counterplay: Shakora purification/cooling rites (or abundant water + careful venting) reduce Heat Debt by 1.
A full short rest in true shade/shelter reduces Heat Debt by 1 (in Emberwood, this may require scouting).
Emberkin renewal rite: burn something old/meaningful to ‘reset’—reduce Heat Debt by 2 but accept a narrative sacrifice.

monster_graft_traits.hook: Targets with Heat Debt ≥2 are easier to track; predator gains advantage on first attack after hiding.
Once per encounter, the monster can dash through hazardous heat without penalty and leave a 5-ft ember patch (difficult terrain).
When reduced to 0 HP, the monster leaves a smoldering cocoon; if not quenched/purified, it reforms at 1 HP at end of next round (once).

overlays.notes: Use when Skyward Peaks become a character: storms, trials, and the ‘language of air’ matters.

track.name: Altitude Strain
increase_triggers: Extended climbing/flying without acclimation (failed travel move or CON check).
Exposure to sudden stormfronts/downdrafts (miss/weak hit on wind navigation).
Breaking a vow/ritual respect to the wind in a sacred place (Temple/Cloudspire).

effects: Breathless: speed -5 ft until you take a short rest or receive aid.
Thin-Aired: disadvantage on your next Perception check OR ranged attack roll (your choice).
Storm Oath: the wind demands payment; GM triggers a storm complication (lightning strike risk, forced reroute, or separation).

moves.name: Borrow the Current
moves.trigger: When you attempt a daring traversal using wind-currents (mist bridge, tunnel, glide).
moves.strong_hit: You cross swiftly and safely; reduce Altitude Strain by 1.
moves.weak_hit: You cross, but take Minor Strain or Altitude Strain +1.
moves.miss: A downdraft forces a hard choice: drop gear, split, or take injury.

moves.name: Honor the Wind
moves.trigger: When you perform a breathing rite, vow, or offering to align with Keairvari’s will.
moves.strong_hit: Gain safe passage or shelter; reduce Altitude Strain by 2.
moves.weak_hit: Reduce by 1, but accept a small vow (silence, no fire, no blood on the ledge, etc.).
moves.miss: The rite offends or is incomplete; a storm test arrives soon.

counterplay: Acclimation downtime (half-day) reduces Altitude Strain by 1.
Shelter in a wind-shadow (cave/Cloudspire corridor) + warm drink reduces by 1 on short rest.
Aeris guide assistance: once per day, ignore one trigger that would increase Altitude Strain.

monster_graft_traits.hook: Forced movement increases by 5 ft and the monster can reposition 5 ft as a reaction once per round.
In wind or storm, the monster has advantage on initiative and cannot be surprised.
Creatures with Altitude Strain ≥4 have disadvantage on saves vs being pushed/pulled by this monster.

overlays.notes: Optional. Use when waterways are sacred/politically charged or when the river is actively ‘answering’ behavior.

track.name: Tide Owed
increase_triggers: Polluting a waterway, refusing cleansing, or spilling blood into a sacred current.
Breaking a treaty/promise made ‘by the river’ or denying safe passage unjustly.
Ignoring a clear opportunity to mediate a conflict at the waterline (GM call).

effects: Undertow: your next Athletics/Acrobatics check involving water takes -1 (Minor Strain).
Salt in Wounds: the next healing you receive is reduced by PB (minimum 1).
Cleansing Demand: a flood/tide event forces a choice—confess, sacrifice, or be swept into a new situation.

moves.name: Call the Cleansing
moves.trigger: When you attempt to wash corruption from a place or person using Shakora’s rites.
moves.strong_hit: Reduce Tide Owed by 2 and cleanse the target/source.
moves.weak_hit: Cleanse it, but relocate it; reduce Tide Owed by 1.
moves.miss: It spreads downstream; Tide Owed +1 and an enemy clock advances.

moves.name: Settle by Current
moves.trigger: When you negotiate passage, tribute, or treaty under Shakora’s witness.
moves.strong_hit: Fair settlement; gain a lasting boon (safe route/ally).
moves.miss: The current turns; conflict escalates immediately.

counterplay: Meaningful mediation (ending a conflict without bloodshed) reduces Tide Owed by 1.
Purification ritual + repaired harm (cleanup, restitution) reduces by 2.
Honoring a water taboo for a day (no pollution, no needless violence) reduces by 1 at dawn.

monster_graft_traits.hook: On hit, pull the target 10 ft (or knock prone if no room).
Once per encounter, create a 10-ft zone of difficult terrain that also pushes creatures 5 ft at start of their turn.
When a creature with Rot/Blight effects is hit, the monster can choose to cleanse (remove) or spread (transfer) one minor condition (GM-facing).

overlays.notes: Use when Verdant Valley politics/ecosystems are actively judging extraction vs stewardship.

track.name: Covenant Balance
increase_triggers: Overharvesting, poisoning soil/water, or harming a keystone species.
Refusing stewardship demands after benefiting from the land (weak hit cost ignored).
Allowing rot/parasites to spread through inaction (GM call).

effects: Thornback: the next forced movement you take is reduced by 5 ft (vines catch you); also -1 on next Stealth in dense growth (Minor Strain).
Swarm Response: you must make a CON save or become Poisoned until end of next turn (pollen/ants/spores).
Overgrowth Event: the terrain entangles; escape requires a group effort, restitution, or pruning rite.

moves.name: Prune or Protect
moves.trigger: When you restore balance by pruning, replanting, relocating predators, or negotiating stewardship.
moves.strong_hit: Reduce Covenant Balance by 2 and gain a boon (safe passage, ingredient, ally-beast).
moves.weak_hit: Reduce by 1, but take on an obligation (guard a grove, repay water, etc.).
moves.miss: Your action backfires; balance shifts against you (new hazard, faction anger).

moves.name: Take Without Breaking
moves.trigger: When you harvest something rare under time pressure.
moves.strong_hit: You take it cleanly; no increase to Covenant Balance.
moves.weak_hit: You take it, but Covenant Balance +1 or owe a debt.
moves.miss: You scar the system; Covenant Balance +2 and repercussions start.

counterplay: Restitution (replanting, feeding pollinators, repairing water channels) reduces by 1.
Steward’s rite (community witness + vow) reduces by 2.
Shakora cleansing used respectfully can reduce by 1 if imbalance involved contamination.

monster_graft_traits.hook: Once per encounter, summon a 10-ft swarm zone; creatures inside have disadvantage on one type of check (choose: Perception/Stealth/Concentration).
On hit, target must succeed on STR save or be Restrained until end of its next turn.
If the party harms the environment (fire/acid indiscriminately), the monster gains +PB damage for 1 round.

overlays.notes: This is Khalsarra’s ‘the land remembers’ pressure: it rewards purpose, witness, and mercy; it punishes aimlessness and betrayal.

track.name: Sacred Weight
increase_triggers: Traveling without declared purpose through the Cracked Earth (failed 'Walk With Purpose' or aimless wandering).
Witnessing or exploiting grief-sites (monolith fields, Endless Maw) without ritual respect.
Breaking a vow made to endure (abandoning allies, refusing a needed mercy, betraying a chant-circle).
Prolonged isolation or repeated weak hits that accept 'numbness' costs (GM call).

effects: Weighed: speed -5 ft until you complete a purposeful action (help an ally, uphold a vow, or reach a stated waypoint).
Additionally, your next social check to inspire hope takes -1 (Minor Strain: numbness).
Hope Erosion: you have disadvantage on your next WIS save against fear/despair OR your next death save (your choice when it triggers).
If you choose the WIS save option, also mark Minor Strain.
Despair Spiral: the land answers. GM triggers one: sand-wind of whispers, monolith inscription condemns a choice, or a Wyrmspawn pursuit begins.
Until the spiral is addressed, the party cannot gain the benefits of a long rest in the Cracked Earth.

moves.name: Claim Purpose
moves.trigger: When you state a clear purpose (oath, waypoint, promise) and act on it under pressure.
moves.strong_hit: Reduce Sacred Weight by 2; an ally also clears Minor Strain (witnessed purpose).
moves.weak_hit: Reduce by 1, but the GM names a vow-complication that must be upheld before sunset.
moves.miss: Your purpose is challenged; Sacred Weight +1 and a test appears immediately.

moves.name: Bind the Sorrow
moves.trigger: When you perform Ashwalker-style binding (chant, circle, offering) to keep despair from swallowing someone or a place.
moves.strong_hit: Contain the sorrow; remove Frightened or a despair condition and reduce Sacred Weight by 1.
moves.weak_hit: Contain it, but it leaves a mark: one participant takes Minor Strain or loses a small comfort (GM).
moves.miss: The sorrow echoes; Sacred Weight +1 and the scene escalates.

moves.name: Choose Mercy or Might
moves.trigger: When violence is an easy answer in a place of grief, and you choose a harder path.
moves.strong_hit: You avert bloodshed; reduce Sacred Weight by 2 and gain goodwill or safe passage.
moves.weak_hit: You avert it, but pay a cost: supplies, time, or a vow.
moves.miss: Your restraint is read as weakness; confrontation happens anyway—but on worse terms.

counterplay: A witnessed vow (spoken aloud, agreed by the group) reduces Sacred Weight by 1 immediately.
Completing a declared waypoint/purpose reduces by 1 (once per day).
Ashwalker chant-circle rest: a short rest with a binding chant reduces by 2 (requires quiet and time).
Compassionate act in a despair hotspot (burying the dead, rescuing a lost traveler) reduces by 1.

monster_graft_traits.hook: The monster knows the location of creatures who have Sacred Weight ≥4 within 60 ft unless warded; it prefers them as prey.
Recharge 5–6: create a 10-ft tremor zone; creatures inside must make DEX save or fall prone and gain Minor Strain.
If a creature breaks a declared vow in scene, the monster can react to deal psychic damage or impose Frightened (save).

overlays.notes: Use when the tundra is actively testing the party: veilstorm season, Frostwake, or Shardspire resonance.

track.name: Frost Lock
increase_triggers: Prolonged exposure without proper shelter (failed 'Weather the Veilstorm' or missed travel shelter checks).
Crossing thin ice or aurora paths recklessly (miss/weak hit costs).
Frostwake events (thaws) that release ancient cold and then snap-freeze again.
Lingering near Shardspire/Veilspire in open air during storm hours (GM call).

effects: Chilled: disadvantage on your next Athletics or Sleight of Hand check (fingers numb).
Also, your speed is reduced by 5 ft until you warm up at a shelter.
Frozen Tempo: you cannot take reactions until the start of your next turn (you move like glass).
Additionally, your next saving throw vs cold or restraint is made at -1 (Minor Strain: brittle breath).
Brittle Stasis: the tundra tries to preserve you. GM triggers one: partial encasement (restrained), gear freeze (weapon/tool disabled), or forced separation by whiteout.
Until addressed, long rest benefits are reduced (no exhaustion recovery, or no hit dice recovery—GM choose).

moves.name: Claim Shelter
moves.trigger: When you secure shelter against storm and cold (cairn, cave, citadel niche) under time pressure.
moves.strong_hit: Shelter holds; reduce Frost Lock by 2 and keep supplies.
moves.weak_hit: Shelter holds, but choose: lose supplies, take Minor Strain, or attract a watcher.
moves.miss: False shelter; a veilstorm complication hits immediately.

moves.name: Read the Ice Runes
moves.trigger: When you interpret cracks/aurora patterns like a Whisperer to avoid disaster.
moves.strong_hit: Reduce Frost Lock by 1 and learn a safe route/omen (ask 2 questions).
moves.weak_hit: Learn one truth, but Frost Lock +1 or pay time/supplies.
moves.miss: Misread; route leads into hazard or an awakened horror’s path.

moves.name: Share the Warmth
moves.trigger: When you prevent isolation from killing the group (shared heat, witness, rotation of watch).
moves.strong_hit: Clear Minor Strain from two allies; reduce Frost Lock by 1 for the group.
moves.weak_hit: Clear one ally, but you take Minor Strain (you carry the fatigue).
moves.miss: Morale cracks; separation or panic triggers a hard move.

counterplay: A true shelter short rest reduces Frost Lock by 1; a fortified shelter reduces by 2.
Fire/heat used carefully (without attracting storms/predators) reduces by 1.
Aurora-path navigation done respectfully can prevent one trigger per day.
Frostborn cairn offering grants a one-time immunity to increasing Frost Lock for the next travel scene.

monster_graft_traits.hook: At initiative 20 (lair), a chill pulse forces CON saves or applies Chilled (or Frost Lock +1 in overlay scenes).
If a Chilled/Frozen target takes bludgeoning, the monster adds +PB damage (glass-shatter moment).
On hit, reduce target speed by 10 ft; if already reduced, impose Restrained until end of next turn (save).

overlays.notes: This overlay is primarily for Gloomwood; use elsewhere only for special intrusions/plot.

track.name: Memory Strain
increase_triggers: Deep Gloom travel (auto-start at 1/day) or failing Gloomwood navigation moves.
Speaking taboo names or telling lies within hush pockets (GM call).
Confronting memory-catching phenomena (webs/echoes) without an anchor.

effects: Lose a minor detail (a name, a route, a promise) until you rest with a witness.
Disadvantage on your next concentration check OR Insight check (choose when triggered).
Haunted Break: GM triggers a shadow move (panic, isolation, false memory, bargain).

moves.name: Walk Where Others Vanish
moves.trigger: When you navigate purposeful shadow paths or attempt stealth through living hush.
moves.strong_hit: You pass unseen and keep bearings; reduce Memory Strain by 1.
moves.weak_hit: You pass, but pay a memory cost: lose time/detail or leave an echo.
moves.miss: You are rerouted; the forest takes you where it wants you.

moves.name: Perform the Lightward
moves.trigger: When you do a grounding rite with witness and record (names, vows, marks).
moves.strong_hit: Reduce Memory Strain by 2 for the party and secure safe rest.
moves.weak_hit: Reduce by 1, but the rite draws attention.
moves.miss: A verse is wrong; Memory Strain +1 and something watches.

counterplay: Witness rest: an ally repeats your name/purpose; reduce Memory Strain by 1.
Coastal rhythm/song (near Shakora border) reduces by 1 at dusk.
Recording names/intentions physically (charcoal/stone) prevents one detail-loss once per day.

monster_graft_traits.hook: On hit, add a memory thread; at 3 threads the target is Confused-like (short duration).
Reaction: when a creature speaks/casts verbally, impose a save vs Silenced or reposition.
Project familiar voice once per encounter; targets must save or be drawn 10 ft.

overlays.notes: Primarily for Sable Mire; use elsewhere only for outbreaks/intrusions.

track.name: Blight Track
increase_triggers: Fail CON saves vs spores/disease/tainted water; take necrotic/poison wounds in the Mire.
Spending a day in the Outer Mire (auto-start 1) or Deep Mire (auto-start 2).
Ignoring infection sources or carrying contaminated gear without cleansing.

effects: Disadvantage on the next healing received until you rest (life resists being reclaimed).
-5 ft speed; coughing spores under stress (social/stealth complication).
Outbreak: GM triggers a rot move—hallucinations, spread, or a Mire entity is drawn to you.

moves.name: Rot Spreads in Silence
moves.trigger: When you try to contain infection in the field.
moves.strong_hit: Contain it; learn the source; reduce Blight by 1.
moves.weak_hit: Contain it, but it costs time/supplies or Blight +1 to someone.
moves.miss: It blooms; Blight +1 and a Mire complication.

moves.name: Brew Against the Blight
moves.trigger: When you craft remedy/ward from Mire ingredients under pressure.
moves.strong_hit: Reduce Blight by 1 and make an extra dose.

counterplay: Clean water immersion + bandage change reduces Blight by 1.
Field antitoxin (outer mire craft) reduces by 1 (once per short rest).
Shakora cleansing rites reduce by 2 if performed at a true spring.
Controlled burn (where safe) can clear one spore hazard without changing Blight, but may create smoke attention.

monster_graft_traits.hook: On taking damage, release a 10-ft spore cloud (CON save or Poisoned).
At initiative 20 (lair), webbing shifts to restrain or separate.
Once per encounter, reanimate as spore-form at 1 HP unless purified/burned.
